# Fotobank

> Fotobank is a self-hosted photo system of record built on Docbank. The project is pre-alpha.

## Product overview

- [Website Markdown](/index.md): Purpose, division of responsibility, and current status.
- [Storage and editing guide](/guide.md): How one photograph moves from import through recovery.

## Technical documentation

- [Documentation](/docs/): Current architecture and operational boundaries.
- [System map](/docs/architecture/): Package ownership and rules for changing the code.
- [Content and storage](/docs/architecture/content-and-storage/): Docbank, NAS, thumbnails, imports, and checkouts.
- [Data model](/docs/architecture/data-model/): Assets, files, albums, shares, and ownership.
- [Search and AI](/docs/architecture/search-and-ai/): Current search and optional AI implementation.

## User and agent workflows

- [Setup](/docs/guides/setup/): Configure storage, diagnose availability, and start the server.
- [Import and recover](/docs/guides/import/): Import, finish interrupted imports, and refresh photo locations through the daemon, with structured results for automation.
- [Checkouts](/docs/guides/checkouts/): Create working copies, scan edits, inspect saved state, and explicitly commit.
- [Backup and restore](/docs/guides/backup/): Archive both the catalog and content, schedule backups, and restore separately.
- [Automation](/docs/guides/automation/): Structured output, daemon requirements, and current command and API limits.
